historyflag.title: History
historyflag.remarks: Specifies whether to include PR records that are stored in history, rather than just current records, in the query. Records stored in history are closed, cancelled, etc. If the check box is selected, records stored in history will be included in the query results. If the check box is cleared, only current records will be included in the query results.

customernum.title: Customer #
customernum.remarks: Number used by the vendor to identify your company.

currencycode.title: Currency
currencycode.remarks: Identifies the currency the PR is in.

pcardnum.title: Procurement Card #
pcardnum.remarks: Procurement Card Number Crosses over from MR.PCARDNUM or LABOR.PCARDNUM

totalcost.title: Total Cost
totalcost.remarks: Total cost for the PR, including taxes. Maximo calculates this amount using the value in the Currency field. If the Currency field is blank, Maximo calculates this amount in your company's base currency.

totaltax1.title: Total Tax
totaltax1.remarks: Total Tax applied to the PR. Maximo calculates this amount based on the line items entered on the PR Lines tab.

buyahead.title: Buy Ahead Rate
buyahead.remarks: Is this a buy ahead rate, ie entered directly by the user and not calculated from the list of active exchange rate.

contact.title: Contact
contact.remarks: Primary person to contact at the vendor.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site for the PR.

prnum.title: PR
prnum.remarks: Identifies the purchase requisition record. This value must be unique for all PR records.

contractrefrev.title: Contract Revision
contractrefrev.remarks: Revision number of the referenced contract.

shipto.title: Ship To
shipto.remarks: Address code where the order will be shipped.

inclusive5.title: Include Tax 5
inclusive5.remarks: Is the PR total inclusive of Tax 5.

inclusive4.title: Include Tax 4
inclusive4.remarks: Is the PR total inclusive of Tax 4.

billtoattn.title: Attention
billtoattn.remarks: Person to whom the bill will be sent.

pcardexpdate.title: Procurement Card Expiration
pcardexpdate.remarks: Procurement Card Expiration Crosses over from MR.PCARDEXPDATE or LABOR.PCARDEXPDATE

inclusive1.title: Pay Tax to Vendor
inclusive1.remarks: Specifies if the vendor is authorized to collect taxes and you will pay the tax amount to the vendor. Select the checkbox if you want to pay taxes to the vendor. Clear the checkbox if there is no tax, or if you want to pay taxes directly to the taxing authority.

priority.title: Priority
priority.remarks: Priority level used to determine the order in which requisitions should be turned into purchase orders. We recommend that limit your range of values from 0 to 9, where 0 is the lowest priority. The default value is 0.

inclusive3.title: Include Tax 3
inclusive3.remarks: Is the PR total inclusive of Tax 3

inclusive2.title: Include Tax 2
inclusive2.remarks: Is the PR total inclusive of Tax 2

inspectionrequired.title: Inspection Required
inspectionrequired.remarks: Specifies whether this item requires an approval of the receipt. When you receive items that require inspection, Maximo records a receipt transaction. However, the item does not appear in the storeroom until the receipt is approved. If the check box is selected, the item requires inspection. If the check box is cleared (the default), no approval of the receipt is necessary.

shipvia.title: Ship Via
shipvia.remarks: Specifies how the goods should be shipped. For example, First Class Mail.

fob.title: FOB Point
fob.remarks: Free On Board Point. The point where responsibility and liability are transferred. The FOB point is usually either the destination or the shipping point.

shiptoattn.title: Attention
shiptoattn.remarks: Person to whom the order is being shipped.

pcardtype.title: Procurement Card Type
pcardtype.remarks: Procurement Card Type Crosses over from MR.PCARDTYPE or LABOR.PCARDTYPE

storelocsiteid.title: Storeroom Site
storelocsiteid.remarks: Identifies the site where the storeroom is located.

requireddate.title: Required Date
requireddate.remarks: Date the PR items are needed.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.remarks: Person responsible for approving the work to be done. For example, the person who oversees the services provided by a contractor.

prla5.title: PRLA5
prla5.remarks: Extra Crossover Field Crosses over from MR.MRLA5 or LABOR.LA25

internal.title: Internal
internal.remarks: Specifies if the requisition is an internal requisition or an external requisition. If the check box is selected, the requisition is an internal requisition, which means that the item supplier is within your company. You must enter a storeroom location for the item on the PR Lines tab. Internal requisitions can only be for inventory material from a storeroom, not for a service. If the check box is cleared, the item vendor is external to your company, and may be either inventory material or a service.

prla4.title: PRLA4
prla4.remarks: Extra Crossover Field Crosses over from MR.MRLA4 or LABOR.LA24

paymentterms.title: Payment Terms
paymentterms.remarks: Specified terms of payment for this vendor. For example, net 30.

prla3.title: PRLA3
prla3.remarks: Extra Crossover Field Crosses over from MR.MRLA3 or LABOR.LA23

prla2.title: PRLA2
prla2.remarks: Extra Crossover Field Crosses over from MR.MRLA2 or LABOR.LA22

prla1.title: PRLA1
prla1.remarks: Extra Crossover Field Crosses over from MR.MRLA1 or LABOR.LA21

exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.remarks: Exchange rate at time of PR approval.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the purchase requisition. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

requestedby.title: Requested By
requestedby.remarks: Person who asked for the PR. The default value is the current login ID.

vendor.title: Company
vendor.remarks: Identifies the vendor for the item.

payonreceipt.title: Pay on Receipt
payonreceipt.remarks: Specifies whether you have a pay on receipt agreement with the vendor. If the check box is selected, Maximo will generate an invoice upon receipt of the item or service. If the check box is cleared (the default), no invoice is generated.

description_longdescription.title: Details
description_longdescription.remarks: Long Description for Purchase Requisition Description

storeloc.title: Storeroom
storeloc.remarks: Storeroom location of the item. This field is required if the Issue on Receipt? check box on the PR Lines tab is cleared.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date and time that the PR status was last changed. The default is the system date and time at the time of the status change.

statusiface.title: Has Status Changed
statusiface.remarks: Non persistent boolean field to indicate whether the status has been changed after the stateful object is fetched from the database.

freightterms.title: Freight Terms
freightterms.remarks: Describes what is being shipped. Any riders to the shipping agreement should be included here. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button. For example, Fresh Fruit. Perishable. Must meet delivery dates.

billto.title: Bill To
billto.remarks: Address code where the order will be billed.

contractrefnum.title: Contract Reference
contractrefnum.remarks: Contract that was used to find the price.

novendor.title: No Vendor
novendor.remarks: Specifies whether this PR is for a particular vendor. If the checkbox is selected, no vendor will be specified on this PR. If the checkbox is cleared, you may specify particular vendors for line items on the PR Lines tab.

np_statusmemo.title: Change Status Memo
np_statusmemo.remarks: Status change memo, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA
